criteria.description: The #4891 CLI pin passes: accept succeeds when lanes.json and a passing matrix are present, and both controls report 2 passed.
criteria.evidence: uv run pytest tests/specify_cli/cli/commands/test_issue_4891_accept_missing_lanes.py -q -> 2 passed (109 s) on lane-a head fbacb48f93; red before the change on pristine origin/main (1 failed, 1 passed, IMPLEMENTATION_UNREADABLE).

criteria.description: Both controls are built by one shared fixture builder and differ only by lanes.json and the acceptance matrix.
criteria.evidence: Instrumented run of the negative control reports blocked checks ['lanes_manifest'] only; both tests call _build_accept_ready_mission and only the positive control writes lanes.json.
criteria.notes: FR-002 / SC-003, reviewed in round 2 after round 1 rejected the asymmetric fixture.

criteria.description: The fixture satisfies the post-#6715/#5939 landing axes honestly (authored owned_files, lane-branch implementation commit, independent approval), and each part is load-bearing.
criteria.evidence: Half-by-half reverts each turn the positive control red with the matching code: no implementation commit -> IMPLEMENTATION_UNREADABLE; no owned_files -> IMPLEMENTATION_MISSING; approval by the implementer -> REVIEW_NOT_INDEPENDENT.
criteria.notes: FR-003 / SC-002; no gate was mocked or waived.
